hook: I get so many questions about how I make these digital scrapbook carousels on Instagram, so I'm gonna show you guys. Start with your background photo and then go to elements and search for polaroid. Go to the frame section and then lay out the polaroid frames wherever you like them best. Then select photos in your digital scrapbook post. Once you're happy with that, this is really where the magic happens. Search for shadows, then line it up with the different polaroids in your design. Adjust layers so that it falls behind the frame. Repeat this for every single one of the elements. If you do one it's a nice effect to do all. And if it looks too harsh, you can always turn down the transparency. This is optional but I always like to add more scrapbooking elements to make it feel like a true digital scrapbook! To find the elements that I have here, just search tape, pen and doodles.
